Lemma
[time reversal of the Jacobi system]

↗ def:dc-ch5-2-1

Let $\gamma $ be a geodesic on $[a,b]$ and let $(J,DJ)$ be a Jacobi pair along it. Then $t\mapsto \gamma (-t)$ is a geodesic on $[-b,-a]$, and

\[ J^-(t)=J(-t),\qquad DJ^-(t)=-DJ(-t) \]

is a Jacobi pair along it.
Proof

\sketch Substitute $t\mapsto -t$ into the chart Jacobi system. Bilinearity supplies the signs in the connection terms, while the two reversed velocity slots leave the curvature term unchanged.

□
